texts.orig: Principles
texts.text: Principles

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Following are the Principles that provide the foundation for the Plan to address the waiting list in Pennsylvania.  All decisions and actions related to the provision of mental retardation services and supports are to be weighed against these principles.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Everyday Lives
texts.text: Everyday Lives

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Everyday Lives, published in 1991, expresses the values upon which the Pennsylvania Mental Retardation Service System is based. Everyday Lives presented what people with disabilities said is important to them.
texts.text: Everyday Lives, published in 1991, expresses the values upon which the Pennsylvania Mental Retardation Service System is based. Everyday Lives presented what people with disabilities said is important to them.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Choice - in the decisions of life; choice of jobs, friends, recreation, where and with whom to live.
texts.text: Choice - in the decisions of life; choice of jobs, friends, recreation, where and with whom to live.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Control - of relationships, money, transportation, services, medicine and staff.
texts.text: Control - of relationships, money, transportation, services, medicine and staff.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Permanency - with a life in the community among family and friends; no fear of returning to the institution.
texts.text: Permanency - with a life in the community among family and friends; no fear of returning to the institution.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Security - and protection for those who have difficulty in communication; competent services; and safety in the community.
texts.text: Security - and protection for those who have difficulty in communication; competent services; and safety in the community.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Freedom - of movement, and from stigma.
texts.text: Freedom - of movement, and from stigma.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Prosperity - freedom from poverty and a chance to be successful.
texts.text: Prosperity - freedom from poverty and a chance to be successful.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Individuality - by having a name and a personal history and by making a difference; having dignity and status.
texts.text: Individuality - by having a name and a personal history and by making a difference; having dignity and status.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Relationships - with friends, family and partners.
texts.text: Relationships - with friends, family and partners.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Recognition - of abilities, capacities and gifts.
texts.text: Recognition - of abilities, capacities and gifts.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Privacy - of records, files and histories; protection from being labeled and the option of living alone.
texts.text: Privacy - of records, files and histories; protection from being labeled and the option of living alone.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Citizenship - as part of the community, having a feeling of connectedness, partnership in dreams and beliefs; playing a part in decisions which affect you.
texts.text: Citizenship - as part of the community, having a feeling of connectedness, partnership in dreams and beliefs; playing a part in decisions which affect you.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Passion - in advocates and self-advocates to fight and dream together.
texts.text: Passion - in advocates and self-advocates to fight and dream together.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Multi-Year Plan
texts.text: Multi-Year Plan

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The Multi-Year Plan, published in 1997, builds on the promise of Everyday Lives in terms of goals, recommendations, and action steps.  The Multi-Year Plan is a plan for the future which provides a backdrop for recommendations to address the waiting list in Pennsylvania.  It included a major goal to realign resources to meet the needs of those on the waiting list.  While resource realignment has addressed the need of some people on the waiting list, we have concluded that the realignment of resources alone will not provide sufficient resources to meet the needs of all who are on the waiting list.
texts.text: The Multi-Year Plan, published in 1997, builds on the promise of Everyday Lives in terms of goals, recommendations, and action steps.  The Multi-Year Plan is a plan for the future which provides a backdrop for recommendations to address the waiting list in Pennsylvania.  It included a major goal to realign resources to meet the needs of those on the waiting list.  While resource realignment has addressed the need of some people on the waiting list, we have concluded that the realignment of resources alone will not provide sufficient resources to meet the needs of all who are on the waiting list.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Two major goals:
texts.text: Two major goals:

texts.label: text
texts.orig: System Reform: restructuring the system to one that is: ConsumerDriven, Values-Based, Outcome-Oriented, and Cost-Efficient.
texts.text: System Reform: restructuring the system to one that is: ConsumerDriven, Values-Based, Outcome-Oriented, and Cost-Efficient.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Resource Realignment: realigning existing resources to meet the needs of those on the waiting list while maintaining necessary supports and services for individuals currently receiving them.
texts.text: Resource Realignment: realigning existing resources to meet the needs of those on the waiting list while maintaining necessary supports and services for individuals currently receiving them.
